templates.reminder: Hi {{firstName}}, this is a reminder of your {{serviceName}} appointment at {{businessName}} on {{appointmentDate}} at {{appointmentTime}}. Reply YES to confirm or NO to cancel.
templates.reminderNoConfirm: Hi {{firstName}}, see you on {{appointmentDate}} at {{appointmentTime}} for your {{serviceName}} at {{businessName}}.
templates.confirmed: Thanks {{firstName}}, you are confirmed for {{appointmentDate}} at {{appointmentTime}}. See you then.
templates.cancelled: Your appointment on {{appointmentDate}} at {{appointmentTime}} has been cancelled. Rebook any time: {{bookingUrl}}
templates.reschedulePrompt: No problem {{firstName}} — pick a new time here: {{bookingUrl}}
templates.missedCall: Hi, this is {{businessName}} — sorry we missed your call. Reply here and we will help, or book directly: {{bookingUrl}}
templates.missedCallAfterHours: Hi, this is {{businessName}}. We are closed right now but saw your call. Reply here and we will get back to you first thing, or book online: {{bookingUrl}}
templates.waitlistOffer: Hi {{firstName}}, a {{serviceName}} slot just opened on {{appointmentDate}} at {{appointmentTime}}. Reply YES within {{expiryMinutes}} minutes to claim it.
templates.followUpRating: Thanks for visiting {{businessName}} today, {{firstName}}. How did we do, 1 to 5?
templates.reviewRequest: That is great to hear. Would you mind leaving us a quick review? {{reviewUrl}}
templates.privateFeedback: Sorry to hear that. Could you tell us what went wrong? Your reply goes straight to the owner.
templates.recall: Hi {{firstName}}, it has been {{intervalDays}} days since your last {{serviceName}} at {{businessName}}. Ready to book again? {{bookingUrl}}
templates.helpReply: {{businessName}}: reply YES to confirm an appointment, NO to cancel, or STOP to opt out. Call us on {{supportPhone}}.
